source.name: BWSSB Kadubeesanahalli CPCB Hourly AQI Data 2017–2023
source.original_source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) via airquality.cpcb.gov.in
data_limitations: AQI index metric only; does not contain raw pollutant concentrations (PM2.5, PM10, etc.)
Must not be used for PM2.5 concentration prediction or ML model training
Upper cap at AQI 500 for extreme events
Irregular missing gaps and partial months (e.g., October 2017, November 2017)
Source times are unverified against official CPCB portal headers, presumed IST (UTC+05:30) per CAAQMS standard

timezone_confidence.note: CPCB CAAQMS monitoring stations natively log in IST. The source CSV lacks explicit UTC offset or timezone headers, so timestamps are preserved as source-local with unverified status.

coordinate_confidence.note: Coordinates derived from external CPCB/BWSSB STP directory references; not verified against KSRSAC official KML registry.
